modal.heading: Cancel pre-order
modal.body: Do you want to cancel your pre-order? This can't be undone.
modal.noCharge: You haven't been charged yet, and you won't be charged later.
modal.refund: You'll get the full amount back on the card you paid with.
modal.done: We've cancelled your pre-order. You'll get a confirmation by email.
modal.doneRefund: We've cancelled your pre-order and your refund is on its way to your card. You'll get a confirmation by email.
modal.error: Your pre-order couldn't be cancelled here. Please contact us and we'll help.
